2609.37272.title: Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals for Non-Injective Neural Mappings
2609.37272.paper_summary: Non-injective mappings in neural networks map distinct inputs to the same representation, thereby implicitly inducing equivalence relations in the input space. However, the input differences eliminated by these mappings may still be required by downstream tasks, creating a mismatch between operator-induced indistinguishability and task-required distinctions. For non-injective linear operators realized in the current forward pass, their null spaces exactly characterize these invisible input variations. We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework for non-injective linear mappings. NSR combines null-space component extraction from pre-mapping representations, member-level encoding and gating, and application-specific integration to exploit potentially task-relevant information under downstream supervision while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules. We evaluate NSR in two structurally different settings: token merging and graph aggregation. In token merging, NSR achieves higher semantic segmentation performance than the corresponding compressed baselines in 34 out of 36 evaluated configurations, with a maximum observed gain of 31.51 mIoU points under strong compression. In graph aggregation, NSR achieves 100% training accuracy on Tree-NeighborsMatch at depths d=2--6 across three backbones, alongside gains on heterophilic node classification and molecular graph regression. Together, these results support null-space residuals as a practical complement to non-injective linear mappings, enabling downstream models to learn from input distinctions invisible in the original operator's output.
2609.37272.paper_summary_zh: 非單射映射在神經網絡中將不同的輸入映射到相同的表示，從而在輸入空間中隱含地引入等價關係。<lb/>然而，這些映射消除的輸入差異可能仍然是下游任務所需的，造成操作員引起的不可區分性與任務所需的區別之間的不匹配。<lb/>對於在當前前向傳遞中實現的非單射線性運算符，它們的零空間恰好表徵了這些不可見的輸入變化。<lb/>我們提出了任務相關的零空間殘差（NSR），這是一個針對非單射線性映射的通用殘差框架。<lb/>NSR結合了從預映射表示中提取的零空間組件、成員級編碼和閘控，以及特定應用的整合，以在下游監督下利用潛在的任務相關信息，同時保留原始的聚合或合併規則。<lb/>我們在兩個結構上不同的設置中評估NSR：標記合併和圖聚合。<lb/>在標記合併中，NSR在36個評估配置中的34個中達到了比相應壓縮基準更高的語義分割性能，並在強壓縮下觀察到最大增益為31.51 mIoU點。<lb/>在圖聚合中，NSR在三個骨幹的深度d=2--6上對Tree-NeighborsMatch達到了100%的訓練準確率，同時在異質節點分類和分子圖回歸上也取得了增益。<lb/>總體而言，這些結果支持零空間殘差作為非單射線性映射的實用補充，使下游模型能夠從原始運算符輸出中不可見的輸入區別中學習。
